BloodDetonation.name: Blood Detonation
BloodDetonation.description: Enemies at maximum Bleed stacks explode for twice their remaining Bleed damage, hurting themselves and nearby foes. Consumes Bleed and replaces Blood Transfer.

BloodPactPower.name: Crimson Power
BloodPactPower.description: Bleed deals 70% more damage, but you attack 30% slower.

BloodPactSpeed.name: Frenzied Blood
BloodPactSpeed.description: Attack 40% faster, but deal 25% less attack damage.

CrescentEruptionPact.name: Sudden Eruption
CrescentEruptionPact.description: Your waves no longer slow enemies. Lingering Wake erupts after 0.3 seconds for all its damage at once. Your slow upgrades become Wave Damage.

CrescentFieldPact.name: Scorched Wake
CrescentFieldPact.description: Lingering Wake deals 50% more damage, but wave hits deal 30% less damage.

CrescentPowerPact.name: Crushing Tide
CrescentPowerPact.description: Waves deal 50% more damage, but travel 50% slower.

IaijutsuDashPact.name: Relentless Steps
IaijutsuDashPact.description: Your Iaijutsu marks no longer amplify damage. Killing a marked enemy reduces dash recharge by 0.3 seconds instead. Exposed Weakness ranks become Iaijutsu Damage.

IaijutsuMarkPact.name: Focused Malice
IaijutsuMarkPact.description: Double the damage bonus from Iaijutsu marks, but your slashes are 20% narrower.

IaijutsuPowerPact.name: Patient Blade
IaijutsuPowerPact.description: Iaijutsu slashes deal 50% more damage, but take 30% longer to charge.

AfterimageFrenzy.name: Afterimage Frenzy
AfterimageFrenzy.description: Shadow Clones attack 200% faster. Their Returning Fangs travel 200% faster instead.

BarrageStance.name: Barrage Stance
BarrageStance.description: Gain 30% attack speed and 2 extra projectiles. Kunai inflict poison: each stack deals 5% of its hit damage over 5 seconds. Hits refresh all stacks, up to 20. Choose one Ninja stance per run.

BreakingWheel.name: Breaking Wheel
BreakingWheel.description: When a blade expires, it releases a circular slash dealing 75% blade damage. Larger blades create larger slashes.

Crescendo.name: Crescendo
Crescendo.description: Gain 1 extra projectile every 3 attacks, up to 5. Fire at full strength, then build up again. Each additional rank raises the limit by 2.

CuttingReturn.name: Cutting Return
CuttingReturn.description: Returning Fang also strikes enemies on its way back to you.

EmbeddedBlades.name: Embedded Blades
EmbeddedBlades.description: Ninja hits embed blades in enemies, up to 12 per enemy. On death, they scatter toward nearby foes for 40% of their original hit damage. Scattered blades cannot embed again.

FinalPursuit.name: Final Pursuit
FinalPursuit.description: When Returning Fang kills an enemy, it seeks one more nearby target before returning.

FocusedVolley.name: Focused Volley
FocusedVolley.description: Your volleys have 65% less spread, concentrating their fire.

ForkingProjectiles.name: Forked Blades
ForkingProjectiles.description: Kunai have a 15% chance to split on impact into 2 blades dealing 50% damage each. Split blades apply poison but cannot split again.

FragmentLoad.name: Barbed Blades
FragmentLoad.description: Embed 1 additional blade with each hit.

FragmentReach.name: Scattering Blades
FragmentReach.description: Scattered blades seek enemies from 15% farther away.
FragmentReach.format: Scattered blades seek enemies from {Percent}% farther away.

GreatShuriken.name: Giant Shuriken Stance
GreatShuriken.description: Throw massive piercing blades that repeatedly cut enemies. Gain 50% damage and throw 50% slower. Extra projectiles increase blade size. Choose one Ninja stance per run.

GrindingHalt.name: Grinding Halt
GrindingHalt.description: Each blade slows to 15% speed for 1 second on its first elite or boss hit.

NeedleRain.name: Needle Rain
NeedleRain.description: Every fourth attack fires twice as many kunai.

RelentlessFang.name: Relentless Fang
RelentlessFang.description: Consecutive hits from the same Fang against an enemy gain 15% damage per hit, up to 75%. Hitting another enemy resets the bonus.

ReturningFang.name: Returning Fang Stance
ReturningFang.description: Throw a homing Fang that strikes, returns harmlessly, and immediately launches again. Fighting close speeds up its cycle. Attack speed increases flight speed; extra projectiles grant 25% Fang damage each.

SerratedEdge.name: Serrated Edge
SerratedEdge.description: Each blade gains 15% damage against an enemy for every previous contact hit, up to 75%. Bursts benefit from this bonus without increasing it.

ShadowStep.name: Shadow Step
ShadowStep.description: Dashing as Ninja leaves a Shadow Clone that attacks once with your current weapon.

VenomousKunai.name: Venomous Blades
VenomousKunai.description: Ninja attacks inflict Poison, including attacks from Shadow Clones and assists.

WideOrbit.name: Growing Shuriken
WideOrbit.description: Blades grow throughout their lifetime, reaching twice their starting size.

BattleStance.name: Blood Stance
BattleStance.description: Gain 35% attack area and 30% attack speed. Attacks inflict Bleed: each stack deals 12.5% of the hit's damage over 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times; new hits refresh all stacks. Choose one Samurai stance per run.

BladeWave.name: Crescent Stance
BladeWave.description: Replace melee attacks with piercing waves that deal 40% attack damage and slow enemies by 30% for 5 seconds. Choose one Samurai stance per run.

BleedingEdge.name: Bleeding Edge
BleedingEdge.description: Attacks inflict Bleed, dealing damage over time.

BloodAssist.name: Ninja Assist
BloodAssist.description: Each attack has a 5% chance to call Ninja for an assist attack.

BloodCapacity.name: Deep Reserves
BloodCapacity.description: Increase the maximum number of Bleed stacks on each enemy by 1.

BloodCritical.name: Critical Strike
BloodCritical.description: Attacks have a 15% chance to deal double damage.

BloodEcho.name: Echoing Slash
BloodEcho.description: Attacks have a 15% chance to echo for 50% damage. Echoes can inflict Bleed and critically strike, but cannot create further echoes.

BloodRush.name: Blood Rush
BloodRush.description: Killing a bleeding enemy grants 20% movement speed for 3 seconds. Further kills refresh the bonus. Swapping ends it.

BloodTransfer.name: Blood Transfer
BloodTransfer.description: When a bleeding enemy dies, its Bleed stacks spread to nearby enemies.

BloodTransferArea.name: Crimson Reach
BloodTransferArea.description: +10% Blood Transfer and Blood Detonation radius.

Bloodletting.name: Bloodletting
Bloodletting.description: Each hit applies 1 additional Bleed stack.

BurstRadius.name: Expanding Ruin
BurstRadius.description: Increase Overkill Burst's explosion radius by 12%.
BurstRadius.format: Increase Overkill Burst's explosion radius by {Percent}%.

CrescentArc.name: Arc Volley
CrescentArc.description: Attacks have a 15% chance to fire a fan of 3 waves. With Double Cut, the fan fires in all four directions.

CrescentAssist.name: Ninja Assist
CrescentAssist.description: Kills in Crescent Stance have a 5% chance to call Ninja for an assist attack.

CrescentDamage.name: Wave Damage
CrescentDamage.description: Waves and their damaging trails deal 20% more damage.

CrescentDoubleCut.name: Double Cut
CrescentDoubleCut.description: Every fourth attack sends 4 full-damage waves in a cross, each carrying your wave upgrades.

CrescentDoubleCutFrequency.name: Relentless Cuts
CrescentDoubleCutFrequency.description: Double Cut requires 1 fewer attack, down to every attack.

CrescentField.name: Lingering Wake
CrescentField.description: Waves have a 15% chance to leave a trail along their full path after travelling outward. Trails deal 30% wave damage per second for 3 seconds. Their split waves share the effect.

CrescentFieldPower.name: Enduring Wake
CrescentFieldPower.description: +15% Lingering Wake duration and total damage. Also increases Sudden Eruption damage.

CrescentSlow.name: Chilling Waves
CrescentSlow.description: Waves slow enemies by an additional 5%.

CrescentSlowDuration.name: Lingering Chill
CrescentSlowDuration.description: Your waves slow enemies for 1 second longer.

CrescentSplit.name: Splitting Waves
CrescentSplit.description: The first enemy hit has a 15% chance to launch 2 smaller waves sideways while the original continues. Side waves deal 50% damage, have 60% width and range, and cannot split again.

CrossingBlades.name: Crossing Blades
CrossingBlades.description: Every third attack launches 3 crossing waves.

DoubleCut.name: Double Cut
DoubleCut.description: Every fourth attack becomes a full-damage slash that strikes all around you.

DoubleCutFrequency.name: Relentless Cuts
DoubleCutFrequency.description: Double Cut requires 1 fewer attack, down to every attack.

Iaijutsu.name: Iaijutsu Stance
Iaijutsu.description: Charge a slash for 1 second, drawing nearby enemies into its path. Strike the entire path and mark foes for 3 seconds. Marked foes take 50% more damage from later hits. Choose one Samurai stance per run.

IaijutsuAOE.name: Final Flourish
IaijutsuAOE.description: Iaijutsu attacks have a 15% chance to unleash a circular strike at the end of their path, dealing full attack damage within 2.5 meters.

IaijutsuAssist.name: Ninja Assist
IaijutsuAssist.description: While fighting in Iaijutsu Stance, you have a 5% chance each second to call Ninja for an assist attack.

IaijutsuCascadePower.name: Deadly Cascade
IaijutsuCascadePower.description: Death Cascade slashes and their Final Flourish deal 20% more damage.

IaijutsuChain.name: Death Cascade
IaijutsuChain.description: The first kill from an Iaijutsu attack launches a slash from the fallen enemy toward the nearest foe. This slash cannot trigger Death Cascade.

IaijutsuDash.name: Dash Draw
IaijutsuDash.description: Dash twice as far in Iaijutsu Stance. At the end of your dash, charge a slash along the path you travelled.

IaijutsuDashPower.name: Driving Draw
IaijutsuDashPower.description: Dash Draw slashes and their Final Flourish deal 20% more damage.

IaijutsuDoubleCut.name: Double Cut
IaijutsuDoubleCut.description: Every fourth Iaijutsu attack releases 2 full-damage slashes in an X.

IaijutsuDoubleCutFrequency.name: Relentless Cuts
IaijutsuDoubleCutFrequency.description: Double Cut requires 1 fewer attack, down to every attack.

IaijutsuInstant.name: Flash Draw
IaijutsuInstant.description: Iaijutsu attacks have a 15% chance to strike instantly, without charging.

IaijutsuMarkDamage.name: Exposed Weakness
IaijutsuMarkDamage.description: Enemies marked by Iaijutsu take an additional 10% damage.

IaijutsuVacuumReach.name: Gathering Wind
IaijutsuVacuumReach.description: Draw enemies into your Iaijutsu slash from 15% farther away.

LingeringWounds.name: Lingering Wounds
LingeringWounds.description: Bleed lasts 1 second longer and continues dealing damage.

OverkillBurst.name: Overkill Burst
OverkillBurst.description: Melee and wave kills explode, dealing excess damage to nearby enemies. These explosions cannot trigger more explosions.

ReturningBlade.name: Returning Blade
ReturningBlade.description: Waves return to their starting point, striking enemies again for 50% damage. Split waves do not return.

SamuraiArea.name: Attack Area
SamuraiArea.description: Increase Samurai attack area by 15%. Adapts to slash width or wave range when you choose a stance.
SamuraiArea.format: Increase Samurai attack area by {Percent}%. Adapts to slash width or wave range when you choose a stance.

SamuraiHeavyBlade.name: Attack Damage
SamuraiHeavyBlade.description: Samurai attacks deal 20% more damage in any stance.
SamuraiHeavyBlade.format: Samurai attacks deal {Percent}% more damage in any stance.

SamuraiTempo.name: Attack Speed
SamuraiTempo.description: Samurai attacks are 10% faster. Adapts to charge speed or wave speed when you choose a stance.
SamuraiTempo.format: Samurai attacks are {Percent}% faster. Adapts to charge speed or wave speed when you choose a stance.

SplinterWave.name: Splinter Wave
SplinterWave.description: The first hit on each wave's outward and return flight bursts for 30% wave damage to nearby enemies.

WaveMultishot.name: Wave Volley
WaveMultishot.description: Fire 1 additional Blade Wave with each attack.

WideArc.name: Wide Arc
WideArc.description: Blade Waves are 12% wider and deal 12% more damage.
WideArc.format: Blade Waves are {Percent}% wider and deal {Percent}% more damage.

GrandEntrance.name: Grand Entrance
GrandEntrance.description: After swapping, empower your next attack. Samurai strikes all around him within 6 meters. Ninja gains 8 extra projectiles, converted to damage for Returning Fang or size for Great Shuriken. Does not stack.

Handoff.name: Handoff
Handoff.description: After swapping, the incoming hero gains 40% attack speed for 2 seconds.

MarkedBlade.name: Marked Blade
MarkedBlade.description: Samurai attacks mark enemies. Ninja attacks consume these marks to deal bonus damage.

TagTeam.name: Tag Team
TagTeam.description: Every 5 normal attacks, your partner joins the fight. Ninja uses her current weapon; Samurai slashes and knocks enemies back.

FangTwin.name: Twin Fang
FangTwin.description: Every fourth launch sends 2 additional spectral Fangs, seeking different enemies when possible. Spectral Fangs return once and cannot summon more Fangs.

FangResonance.name: Resonant Fang
FangResonance.description: After striking an enemy, each returning Fang releases a burst around you for 50% Fang damage. Bursts cannot trigger Fang effects.

FangDeadeye.name: Deadeye
FangDeadeye.description: Fang hits have a 15% chance to deal double damage.

FangAssist.name: Samurai Assist
FangAssist.description: Completed main-Fang round trips have a 5% chance to call Samurai for an assist attack. Can trigger once per second.

FangSplinter.name: Splintering Fang
FangSplinter.description: Fang kills scatter one kunai for each direct Fang hit the enemy took, including the killing hit. Each kunai deals 40% Fang damage and cannot trigger Fang effects.

FangSpeed.name: Flight Speed
FangSpeed.description: Fangs travel 15% faster on outward and return trips.
FangSpeed.format: Fangs travel {Percent}% faster on outward and return trips.

FangCloseQuarters.name: Close Quarters
FangCloseQuarters.description: Fang hits deal 10% more damage to enemies within 3 metres of you.
FangCloseQuarters.format: Fang hits deal {Percent}% more damage to enemies within 3 metres of you.

FangKillingEdge.name: Killing Edge
FangKillingEdge.description: Fang hits deal 15% more damage to enemies below 30% health.
FangKillingEdge.format: Fang hits deal {Percent}% more damage to enemies below 30% health.

FangTwinFrequency.name: Twin Fang Frequency
FangTwinFrequency.description: Twin Fang requires 1 fewer launch, down to every launch.

FangPressure.name: Relentless Pressure
FangPressure.description: Increases Relentless Fang's damage per stack and maximum bonus by 20% of their base values.

FangResonantReach.name: Resonant Reach
FangResonantReach.description: Resonant Fang bursts have 15% more radius.

FangCriticalChance.name: Deadeye Mastery
FangCriticalChance.description: Adds 10% critical-hit chance to Fang hits.

FangAssistChance.name: Reinforcements
FangAssistChance.description: Adds 5% chance to call Samurai on a completed main-Fang round trip.

FangSplinterPower.name: Splinter Power
FangSplinterPower.description: Splintering Fang kunai deal 20% more damage.

FangFarstrider.name: Farstrider
FangFarstrider.description: Fangs travel 25% slower. Outward hits gain damage with distance travelled, up to 150% bonus damage at 10 metres.

FangRedline.name: Redline
FangRedline.description: Fangs travel 60% faster, but deal 30% less damage.

FangPredator.name: Predator's Price
FangPredator.description: Fang critical hits deal 50% more damage, but noncritical hits deal 25% less damage.

NinjaSpeed.name: Attack Speed
NinjaSpeed.description: Ninja attacks are 15% faster. Converts to Flight Speed with Returning Fang.
NinjaSpeed.format: Ninja attacks are {Percent}% faster. Converts to Flight Speed with Returning Fang.

NinjaCoverage.name: Coverage
NinjaCoverage.description: Kunai and Great Shuriken are 15% larger. Converts to Attack Range with Returning Fang.
NinjaCoverage.format: Kunai and Great Shuriken are {Percent}% larger. Converts to Attack Range with Returning Fang.

BarragePool.name: Toxic Ground
BarragePool.description: Killing an enemy poisoned by your kunai leaves a puddle for 3 seconds. Every 0.5 seconds it applies 1 poison stack, matching the victim's average stack strength. Puddle poison alone cannot create another puddle.

BarrageAssist.name: Samurai Assist
BarrageAssist.description: Each attack has a 5% chance to call a Samurai assist. An active assist cannot overlap itself.

BarrageCritical.name: Critical Strike
BarrageCritical.description: Kunai hits have a 15% chance to deal double damage. Poison inherits the increased hit damage.

BarrageRush.name: Viper's Rush
BarrageRush.description: Killing a poisoned enemy grants 20% movement speed for 3 seconds. Further kills refresh the duration.

BarragePoisonDuration.name: Lingering Venom
BarragePoisonDuration.description: Poison lasts 2 seconds longer, dealing damage at the same rate.

BarragePoisonLoad.name: Venom Load
BarragePoisonLoad.description: Each kunai hit applies 2 additional poison stacks.

BarrageRainFrequency.name: Relentless Rain
BarrageRainFrequency.description: Needle Rain requires 1 fewer attack. At maximum rank, every attack fires twice as many kunai.

BarrageSplitChance.name: Branching Blades
BarrageSplitChance.description: Kunai gain 10% split chance. With Serpent's Procession, each ricochet instead loses 2% less damage.

BarrageAssistChance.name: Reinforcements
BarrageAssistChance.description: Gain 5% chance to call a Samurai assist.

BarragePoisonCap.name: Deep Venom
BarragePoisonCap.description: Enemies can hold 4 additional poison stacks.

BarragePointBlank.name: Point-Blank Barrage
BarragePointBlank.description: Gain 50% attack speed, but kunai travel 70% less distance.

BarrageProcession.name: Serpent's Procession
BarrageProcession.description: Fire kunai one after another in a straight line. They ricochet to 3 additional nearby enemies, losing 25% damage per bounce, but cannot split. Each 10% split chance reduces this loss by 2%.

BarrageBloom.name: Venom Bloom
BarrageBloom.description: Puddles no longer apply poison. Every 0.5 seconds they instead deal 10% of each enemy's remaining poison damage without consuming its stacks.

ShurikenTwin.name: Twin Wheel
ShurikenTwin.description: Every fourth throw launches an additional shuriken.

ShurikenAssist.name: Samurai Assist
ShurikenAssist.description: Shuriken contact and burst kills have a 5% chance to call a Samurai assist.

ShurikenDamage.name: Shuriken Damage
ShurikenDamage.format: Increase blade and burst damage. +{Percent}% per rank.

ShurikenSpeed.name: Attack Speed
ShurikenSpeed.format: Throw shurikens more frequently. +{Percent}% per rank.

ShurikenSize.name: Shuriken Size
ShurikenSize.description: Increase blade size and burst radius. With Blood Hunger, increase size gained per kill instead.
ShurikenSize.format: Increase blade size and burst radius. With Blood Hunger, increase size gained per kill instead. +{Percent}% per rank.

ShurikenTempo.name: Cutting Tempo
ShurikenTempo.description: Increase contact hit and pulse frequency by 15% per rank.

ShurikenGrindDuration.name: Persistent Grind
ShurikenGrindDuration.description: Grinding Halt lasts 0.2 seconds longer per rank.

ShurikenGrowth.name: Unstoppable Growth
ShurikenGrowth.description: Increase maximum blade growth by 20 percentage points per rank. Also raises Blood Hunger's growth cap.

ShurikenBurstPower.name: Shattering Force
ShurikenBurstPower.description: Increase expiry slash and periodic burst damage by 15% per rank.

ShurikenTwinFrequency.name: Twin Frequency
ShurikenTwinFrequency.description: Twin Wheel triggers one throw sooner per rank: every third, second, then every throw.

ShurikenAssistChance.name: Reinforcements
ShurikenAssistChance.description: Increase Samurai Assist chance by 5 percentage points per rank.

ShurikenGrooves.name: Deep Grooves
ShurikenGrooves.description: Serrated Edge gains 3 percentage points more damage per hit and a 15 percentage point higher cap per rank.

ShurikenOrbit.name: Bound Orbit
ShurikenOrbit.description: Blades orbit around you instead of flying forward, but deal 30% less contact damage. Expiry slashes are retained.

ShurikenHunger.name: Blood Hunger
ShurikenHunger.description: Blades start 30% smaller and grow 10% per kill, up to their growth cap. Size upgrades increase growth per kill instead of starting size. Growth resets for each blade.

ShurikenPulse.name: Pulsing Core
ShurikenPulse.description: Blades release a circular burst every second, but deal 35% less contact damage. Cutting Tempo speeds up bursts. Expiry slashes are retained.
